## Added

- `sheet_title` is read from a free-standing heading over the drawing when the
  page prints no labelled title block. Exactly one document in the fourteen-
  dossier corpus carries a title block, so reading only labelled rows left
  thirteen sets with no sheet roles at all and refused them a storey model. A
  heading is a second reading and never a competing one: a page that labels its
  title block is decided exactly as before. The fallback is offered only to a
  page whose line work already says it is a drawing, and a page that names
  three or more different kinds of drawing is read as a sheet index instead of
  as any one of them.
- A sheet may name only the storey it draws — `ԱՌԱՋԻՆ ՀԱՐԿ`, with no word for
  "plan" anywhere on it — and is now read as a floor plan. Deliberately narrow:
  a short line that ENDS on the noun, since the same word runs through a
  dossier's prose and labels levels down the side of an elevation.
- Armenian written on ArmSCII-8 bytes is transliterated back. An older
  Armenian CAD font carries the alphabet on Latin-1 code points and leaves
  every Unicode-facing part of the PDF describing the Latin-1 character that
  byte happens to be, so `ԳԼԽԱՎՈՐ ՀԱՏԱԿԱԳԻԾ` reached a reader as
  `¶ÈÊ²ìàð Ð²î²Î²¶ÆÌ`. Nothing in the file says the letter — the embedded
  program's `post` table has its glyph names stripped and its `cmap` is a
  symbol table — so the code page is the only thing that can supply it, and it
  supplies it exactly. Applies to `dossier` text and to `sheet_title` alike.
  It applies on all four text paths — `dossier`, `text`, `structured` and the
  lopdf interpreter behind `vector`, `classify` and `geo`.
- `/Encoding /Differences` glyph names are read as a source of character
  meaning for a simple font that carries no `ToUnicode` stream.

## Fixed

- **`ET` no longer clears the selected font.** `ET` ends a text OBJECT, not the
  text STATE: a font selected by `Tf` persists until another `Tf` changes it.
  Treating `ET` as a reset meant every text object after the first in a content
  stream decoded through no font at all, so `ԱՌԱՋԻՆ ՀԱՐԿԻ ՀԱՏԱԿԱԳԻԾ` arrived as
  `ԱՌԱՋԻՆ`. This is the single largest change in what the toolkit can read on
  this corpus.
- The garble test that drops an unreadable text layer weighed lowercase and
  Latin vowels, so a page set in Armenian, Greek or Cyrillic capitals scored
  zero on both and had its perfectly good text discarded. Text that is not
  mostly Latin is no longer judged by it.
- A wall drawn as one ring around a whole storey is measured by its mean
  thickness — twice its area over its closed perimeter — rather than by the
  short side of its bounding box, which for such a ring is the size of the
  building. On one corpus dossier that put nine of ten wall polygons outside
  the wall band and left every storey empty.
- A scale borrowed from a sibling page is rejected when it disagrees with the
  scale the page itself prints by more than 10 %, which stopped a floor plan
  declaring 1:100 from being georeferenced at a fitted 1:125.
- An address read off a drawing's title block stops where the next field on
  the line begins. An application form gives the address a line of its own; a
  title block runs it into the client's name, and the name ended up inside the
  address. Only visible now that these pages carry readable text at all.
- A `/Encoding /Differences` array that names only some of a font's codes no
  longer swallows the rest. Word and Distiller name a font's accents and leave
  ASCII to the base encoding; the ASCII fallback was gated on the character map
  being empty, which such a font's map is not, and every page set in it decoded
  to nothing.

## Changed

- Workspace version 0.17.0, reflected in `docs/json-api.md`. No response schema
  changed. What changed is how much of a document the existing fields carry:
  more pages have a `sheet_title` and a classification, fewer carry
  `encoding_issue`, and fewer are flagged for a vision pass. Callers that route
  on `extraction.vlm.reasons` will send less work to a model.
- The classification reason for a page whose own name settles its kind reads
  "the sheet names its own kind" rather than naming a title block, since most
  pages this answers for print none.
